selection_context: Eighth primary hypothesis in this SP500 search, added after other families failed; 2024-2026 prices have already been inspected for other strategies. Historical holdout is not pristine across the broader research program. No new variants after results.
hypothesis: Long-only SPY pullback in established uptrend; original research rule, not a published-paper replication.
entry_signal: At close t: adjusted_close[t]/adjusted_close[t-3]-1 < -1.5 * std(last20 daily adjusted-close returns ending t-1,ddof1), AND adjusted_close[t] > mean(last200 adjusted closes including t). Buy at next regular-session open.
exit_signal: While held, at every close including entry day, queue exit for next regular-session open if adjusted close>=mean(last5 adjusted closes including t), OR 5 held sessions completed. Entry session counts1; exit may occur after a weekend after fifth close.
positions: Long only, at most1position, fixed shares bought using allavailablecash net of entrycost. No leverage, no overlappingtrades. After exit, only thatdaysclose may signal a newnextdayentry. Ignore entrysignalswhileheld. Startflat Jan3,2005; 2004data only warms indicators.
cash: Cash earns exp(lagged DGS3MO annual decimal yield * actual elapsed UTC days/365)-1. Use observation from strictly before previoussessiondate, ffilled, known before overnight holding. Split actualprevclose-to-currentopen and currentopen-to-close accrual so capital spentatopen earns onlyovernightcash. Benchmark applies same rate to allcapital for full close-to-close interval. Daily excess=portfolio total return minus cashbenchmark return.
dividends: Yahoo unadjusted OHLC plus ex-date dividend amounts drivecash ledger. Heldshares cominginto ex-date receive dividendcash beforeopen; newex-dateopenbuyers do not. Ex-date cashcredit approximates actuallaterpaydate; common totalreturn convention, explicitly not payment-date financing proof. SPY split absence verified in source events. Adjustedclose drives signals only.
end_boundaries: Continuousledger acrossdevelopment/validation/holdout; no forcedliquidation at splits orfinaldatasetdate. Final holdings marked officialclose and any pending exit flagged; unrealizedmarkedP&L included, no assumedpostcutofffill.
comparisons: Alwayslongfixedshares SPY from firstsimulatedopen using samecash/dividend/costledger. UnderlyingSPY daily totalreturn for marketbeta/HACalpha diagnostics.
